functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Takes it down and forgets its callbacks. A Bedrock form cannot be taken back: it stays until the player answers, and the answer then lands nowhere.

functions.name: update
functions.description: New pictures in place, the menu left open: a bar that fills, a count that changes. `on_pick` still answers by position. `false` once the player has put it away; a Bedrock form keeps what it showed.
